about: Blake Marks-Dias is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Seattle, Washington area. Providing legal representation in Washington for a variety of different issues, Blake Marks-Dias was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Blake Marks-Dias attended law school. Blake Marks-Dias was enrolled at University of Washington School of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1998. Blake Marks-Dias was admitted to the practice of law in 1998.

Attorneys like Blake Marks-Dias are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.

Blake Marks-Dias represents clients with Business Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Civil Litigation: Defense, Employment Litigation: Defense and Environmental Litigation.
